user.title: Signal (WsRpcServer)
user.description: How should Home Assistant reach Signal?

external.title: Connect to SignalCliNet.WsRpcServer
external.description: WebSocket JSON-RPC bridge to Signal. Leave the invite code empty if the server runs without auth (loopback / trusted network).

data_description.ca_cert: Paste the server's ca.crt when it uses its auto-generated CA.
data_description.account: The Signal account linked on the server, e.g. +380501234567.
data_description.invite_code: One-time code from the server admin (createInvite). Required only when the server has Auth enabled.

link.title: Link your Signal account
link.description:
On your phone open Signal → Settings → Linked devices → Link new device and scan this QR code:

![QR]({qr_url})

The code is valid for about 2 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the access token (expired or revoked). Enter a new invite code.

hassio_confirm.title: Signal server add-on
hassio_confirm.description: The **{addon}** add-on is running. Continue to link your Signal account with a QR code.

link_retry.title: QR code expired
link_retry.description: The code was not scanned in time ({error}). Press **Submit** to show a new QR code.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the server: {error}. If Home Assistant runs in Docker/HAOS, 127.0.0.1 is Home Assistant itself — use the server host's address and make sure the server listens on it.
error.auth_required: The server has authentication enabled ({error}). Enter an invite code.
error.tls_error: TLS error: {error}. For the server's auto-generated CA paste its ca.crt into the CA field.
error.invalid_invite: Invite is invalid or has expired.

abort.unsupported_platform: Managed mode is not available on this system: {error}. Choose "Connect to my own WsRpcServer" instead.
abort.managed_failed: Setting up the Signal server failed: {error}
abort.managed_no_reconfigure: The server is managed by Home Assistant; there is nothing to reconfigure.
abort.addon_required: The Signal server runs as a Home Assistant add-on here. Install it: Settings → Add-ons → Add-on Store → ⋮ → Repositories → add {repo_url} → install **Signal WsRpcServer** → Start. A minute after it starts, Home Assistant shows it under Settings → Devices & services → **Discovered**: click Configure there and scan the QR code.

progress.install: Downloading and installing the Signal server (~150 MB, one time). This can take a few minutes.
progress.link:
On your phone open Signal → Settings → Linked devices → Link new device and scan this QR code:

![QR]({qr_url})

Waiting for the scan (about 2 minutes)…

data_description.recipient: Phone number (+380…), Signal UUID or group id.

data.receive_messages: Fire an event for incoming messages

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a Signal text message to one or more recipients.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which configured account to send from (needed only with several).

recipients.name: Recipients
recipients.description: Phone numbers, UUIDs or group ids.
